41.title: [FILM] Sunset Boulevard (1955)
41.overview: Struggling screenwriter Joe Gillis finds himself living under the roof of Norma Desmond, a faded silent film star clinging to dreams of a triumphant return to Hollywood. What begins as a desperate arrangement soon spirals into an increasingly suffocating entanglement, complicated further by Joe's growing affection for young script reader Betty Schaefer.Widely regarded as one of Belmont-Lawrence Pictures' most celebrated classics.

45.title: [SERIES] Friends (1994–2004)
45.overview: The personal and professional lives of six friends living in the Manhattan borough of New York City.

46.title: [SERIES] The Twilight Zone (1963-1968)
46.overview: The Twilight Zone is a science fiction and fantasy anthology series created and hosted by Charles Brent, premiering in 1963. Each episode tells a self-contained story exploring extraordinary and often unsettling scenarios, from alien encounters and time travel to parallel dimensions, dystopian societies, and the mysteries of life and death.It became one of Belmont-Lawrence's most iconic TV productions following Arthur Lawrence III's departure.

50.title: [FILM] Notting Hill (1999)
50.overview: A famous actress falls in love with the owner of a bookstore, but the paparazzi's fascination with her complicates their bond.

54.title: [FRANCHISE] Marvel Cinematic Universe
54.overview: The Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) is an American media franchise and shared universe centered on a series of superhero films produced by Marvel Studios, based on characters from American comic books published by Marvel Comics. Belmont-Lawrence Global owns the franchise, which includes films, television series, short films, digital series, and literature. The shared universe, much like the original Marvel Universe in comic books, was established by crossing over common plot elements, settings, cast, and characters.

55.title: [SERIES] Shōgun (2024)
55.overview: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.

58.title: [FILM] La Gradiva (2026)
58.overview: A class of French high school students spends a week in Naples and Pompeii. One of them tries to uncover his family's secret, while desire and tension run high in the group.

59.title: [SERIES] Bridgerton (2020-2026)
59.overview: The eight close-knit siblings of the Bridgerton family look for love and happiness in London high society.

60.title: [SERIES] The Americans (2013-2018)
60.overview: At the height of the Cold War, married KGB spies pose as Americans in Washington, D.C.

61.title: [FRANCHISE] The Twilight Saga
61.overview: The Twilight Saga is a series of romantic vampire fantasy films based on the book series Twilight by Stephenie Meyer.

64.title: [SINGLE] leave you (never) (2026)
64.overview: "leave you (never)" is Jasmine Saad’s latest single under BLMG. The track takes the 2000s R&B-pop sound of her early independent releases and elevates it with lush vocal layering and an infectious groove.

65.title: [SINGLE] young & dumb (2020)
65.overview: "young & dumb" is Jasmine Saad’s 2020 self-released single and the unexpected catalyst for her music career. Recorded during the pandemic, the track offers a dreamy and nostalgic take on R&B-pop with candid lyrics about reckless youth and fleeting romance.Though released independently with no label backing, a snippet of the song gained organic traction across TikTok fan edits, ultimately catching the attention of a BLMG A&R and setting her move to Los Angeles in motion.

70.title: [SERIES] Supernatural (2005-2020)
70.overview: When they were boys, Sam and Dean Winchester lost their mother to a mysterious and demonic supernatural force. Subsequently, their father raised them to be soldiers. He taught them about the paranormal evil that lives in the dark corners and on the back roads of America ... and he taught them how to kill it. Now, the Winchester brothers crisscross the country in their '67 Chevy Impala, battling every kind of supernatural threat they encounter along the way.

72.title: [FILM] Finding Emily (2026)
72.overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

73.title: [FILM] Rye Lane (2023)
73.overview: Two twenty-somethings, both reeling from bad break-ups, connect over the course of an eventful day in South London – helping each other deal with their nightmare exes, and potentially restoring their faith in romance.

74.title: [SERIES] Squid Game (2021 - 2025)
74.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

75.title: [SERIES] Alice in Borderland (2020-2025)
75.overview: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

76.title: [FILM] Skyfall (2012)
76.overview: When Bond's latest assignment goes gravely wrong, agents around the world are exposed and MI6 headquarters is attacked. While M faces challenges to her authority and position from Gareth Mallory, the new Chairman of the Intelligence and Security Committee, it's up to Bond, aided only by field agent Eve, to locate the mastermind behind the attack.

77.title: [FILM] Possible Love (2026)
77.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

78.title: [FILM] Hope (2026)
78.overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

79.title: [SERIES] Shrinking (2023)
79.overview: Jimmy is struggling to grieve the loss of his wife while being a dad, friend, and therapist. He decides to try a new approach with everyone in his path: unfiltered, brutal honesty. Will it make things better—or unleash uproarious chaos?

83.title: [FILM] The Witch (2016)
83.overview: In 1630, a farmer relocates his family to a remote plot of land on the edge of a forest where strange, unsettling things happen. With suspicion and paranoia mounting, each family member's faith, loyalty and love are tested in shocking ways.

84.title: [FILM] Blue Heron (2026)
84.overview: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.

85.title: [FILM] Plainclothes (2025)
85.overview: In 1990s New York, an undercover police officer receives an assignment to lure and arrest gay men. However, he's surprised to discover a scintillating connection with one of his targets. As their secret connection deepens and internal pressure to deliver arrests intensifies, he finds himself torn between duty and desire.

86.title: [FILM] Burning (2018)
86.overview: Deliveryman Jong-su is out on a job when he runs into Hae-mi, a girl who once lived in his neighborhood. She asks if he'd mind looking after her cat while she's away on a trip to Africa. On her return, she introduces to Jong-su an enigmatic young man named Ben, who she met during her trip. One day Ben tells Jong-su about his most unusual hobby.

87.title: [FILM] Bad Apples (2026)
87.overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

88.title: [FILM] Anatomy of a Fall (2023)
88.overview: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

89.title: [FILM] Poor Things (2023)
89.overview: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman runs off with a lawyer on a whirlwind adventure across the continents. Free from the prejudices of her times, she grows steadfast in her purpose to stand for equality and liberation.

90.title: [FILM] Oppenheimer (2023)
90.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

91.title: [FILM] Moonlight (2016)
91.overview: The tender, heartbreaking story of a young man’s struggle to find himself, told across three defining chapters in his life as he experiences the ecstasy, pain, and beauty of falling in love, while grappling with his own sexuality.

92.title: [FILM] The Love Hypothesis (2026)
92.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

93.title: [FILM] Love Letter (1995)
93.overview: Hiroko attends the memorial service of her fiancé, Itsuki Fujii, who died in a mountain-climbing incident. Although Itsuki's mother says that their old house is gone, Hiroko records the address listed under his name in his yearbook and sends him a letter. Surprisingly, she receives a reply, and discovers it came from his old classmate, a girl who also happens to be called Itsuki Fujii.

94.title: [SERIES] The Pitt (2025)
94.overview: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

95.title: [SERIES] Pachinko (2022)
95.overview: This sweeping saga chronicles the hopes and dreams of a Korean immigrant family across four generations as they leave their homeland in an indomitable quest to survive and thrive.

96.title: [FRANCHISE] The Hunger Games Universe
96.overview: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.

97.title: [SERIES] Widow's Bay (2026)
97.overview: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

98.title: [SERIES] Gossip Girl (2007)
98.overview: An exclusive group of privileged teens from a posh prep school on Manhattan's Upper East Side whose lives revolve around the blog of the all-knowing albeit ultra-secretive Gossip Girl.

99.title: [SERIES] Modern Family (2009)
99.overview: The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan is a wonderfully large and blended family. They give us an honest and often hilarious look into the sometimes warm, sometimes twisted, embrace of the modern family.

100.title: [SERIES] Stranger Things (2016)
100.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

101.title: [SERIES] Wednesday (2022)
101.overview: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

102.title: [SERIES] Severance (2022)
102.overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

103.title: [FILM] Carol (2015)
103.overview: In 1950s New York, a department-store clerk who dreams of a better life falls for an older, married woman.

104.title: [SERIES] Pluribus (2025)
104.overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

105.title: [SERIES] Slow Horses (2022)
105.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

106.title: [SERIES] Sex and the City (1998)
106.overview: Based on the bestselling book by Candace Bushnell, Sex and the City tells the story of four best friends, all single and in their late thirties, as they pursue their careers and talk about their sex lives, all while trying to survive the New York social scene.

107.title: [FILM] Forrest Gump (1994)
107.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.

108.title: [FILM] Titanic (1997)
108.overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.

109.title: [FRANCHISE] Wizarding World
109.overview: The Wizarding World is a media franchise and shared fictional universe centred on the Harry Potter novel series by J. K. Rowling. A series of films have been in production since 2000, and in that time eleven films have been produced—eight are adaptations of the Harry Potter novels and three are part of the Fantastic Beasts series. The films are owned and distributed by BLG.

110.title: [SHOW] MasterChef (2010)
110.overview: This hit cooking competition series sees award-winning chef Gordon Ramsay and other celebrity chefs put a group of contestants through a series of challenges and elimination rounds, in order to turn one home cook into a culinary master.

111.title: [FILM] Lost in Translation (2003)
111.overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.

112.title: [SERIES] The Diplomat (2023)
112.overview: Amid an international crisis, a US diplomat contends with her high-profile job as ambassador to the UK and her strained marriage to a political star.

113.title: [FILM] Hokum (2026)
113.overview: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

114.title: [FRANCHISE] The Conjuring Universe
114.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.

115.title: [FILM] One Day (2011)
115.overview: After spending the night together on the eve of their college graduation, Dexter and Emma are shown each year on the same date to see where they are in their lives. They are sometimes together, and sometimes not.

116.title: [SERIES] Emily in Paris (2020)
116.overview: New passions. New fashions. New Emily? A plucky American marketing whiz spreads her wings in life and love after landing her dream job in Paris.

117.title: [FRANCHISE] Alien
117.overview: Alien is an American science fiction horror and action media franchise, which began as the 1979 film Alien. The series primarily follows deadly encounters between humans and the extraterrestrial Xenomorphs in the future.

118.title: [FRANCHISE] Toy Story
118.overview: Toy Story is an American media franchise owned by BLG. It centers on toys that, unknown to humans, are secretly living. It began in 1995 with the release of the animated feature film of the same name, which focuses on a diverse group of toys featuring a classic cowboy doll named Sheriff Woody and a modern spaceman action figure named Buzz Lightyear.

119.title: [FRANCHISE] Star Wars
119.overview: Star Wars is an American media franchise. The space opera saga began with the original Star Wars film (1977) and quickly became a worldwide pop culture phenomenon. It has expanded into various films and other media, including television series, video games, novels, comic books, comprising an all-encompassing fictional universe. Star Wars is one of the highest-grossing media franchises of all time and has a large following.

120.title: [SHOW] Love Island USA (2019 - Present)
120.overview: The matchmaking begins as a group of single "Islanders" come together in a stunning villa on a beautiful tropical island, ready to embark on a summer of dating, romance, and ultimately, relationships. Every few days the Islanders pair up and those who are not coupled are at risk of being dumped from the island. Islanders are on the lookout for romance, but the road to love doesn't always run smoothly.

121.title: [SHOW] Love Is Blind (2020 - Present)
121.overview: A social experiment where single men and women look for love and get engaged, all before meeting in person.

122.title: [SHOW] American Idol (2002-2016)
122.overview: Each year, hopeful singers from all over the country audition to be part of one of the biggest shows in American television history. Who will become the new American Idol?

123.title: [SHOW] Married at First Sight (2014 - Present)
123.overview: The cart comes way before the horse in the reality series "Married at First Sight." Based on a hit Danish format, "Married..." features people who agree to participate in an extreme experiment: Each covenants legal marriage with a complete stranger. Specialists -- including a spiritualist, a relationship coach and a sociologist -- use scientific matchmaking methods to determine each couple, who will not have met or had contact with each other until the wedding day. The series then documents the relationships, including honeymoons and other relatable events of married life. After several weeks, each couple must decide whether to remain together or go their individual ways.

124.title: [FILM] Mr. & Mrs. Smith (2005)
124.overview: A husband and wife struggle to keep their marriage alive until they realize they are both secretly working as assassins. Now, their respective assignments require them to kill each other.

125.title: [FRANCHISE] The Fast and the Furious
125.overview: Dominic Toretto is a Los Angeles street racer suspected of masterminding a series of big-rig hijackings. When undercover cop Brian O'Conner infiltrates Toretto's iconoclastic crew, he falls for Toretto's sister and must choose a side: the gang or the LAPD.

126.title: [FRANCHISE] Avatar
126.overview: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization.

127.title: [FILM] The Handmaiden (2016)
127.overview: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.

128.title: [FILM] Parasite (2019)
128.overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

129.title: [FRANCHISE] The Lord of the Rings (2001)
129.overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.

130.title: [SERIES] Peaky Blinders (2013)
130.overview: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.

131.title: [FILM] 27 Dresses (2008)
131.overview: Altruistic Jane finds herself facing her worst nightmare as her younger sister announces her engagement to the man Jane secretly adores.

132.title: [FILM] Little Women (2019)
132.overview: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

133.title: [SERIES] Grey's Anatomy (2005)
133.overview: Follows the personal and professional lives of a group of doctors at Seattle's Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital.

134.title: [SERIES] How to Get Away with Murder (2014)
134.overview: A sexy, suspense-driven legal thriller about a group of ambitious law students and their brilliant, mysterious criminal defense professor. They become entangled in a murder plot and will shake the entire university and change the course of their lives.

135.title: [SERIES] Succession (2018)
135.overview: Follow the lives of the Roy family as they contemplate their future once their aging father begins to step back from the media and entertainment conglomerate they control.

136.title: [EP] no filter (2023)
136.overview: no filter is the debut extended play (EP) by Jasmine Saad, released under BLMG. The 4-track project explores youth, independence, self-assurance, and emotional vulnerability from the perspective of an outspoken young woman navigating life on her own terms.

137.title: [SHOW] 90 Day Fiancé (2014 - Present)
137.overview: Getting through customs is just the beginning. With just 90 days to wed on a fiancé visa, follow international couples as they attempt to overcome cultural barriers and family drama while in search of true love that knows no borders.

140.title: [SERIES] The Rookie (2018 - Present)
140.overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

144.title: [SERIES] 9-1-1 (2018 - Present)
144.overview: Explore the high-pressure experiences of police officers, paramedics and firefighters who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives.

146.title: [FRANCHISE] Mortal Kombat
146.overview: Mortal Kombat is an American media franchise centered on a series of fighting video games originally developed by Midway Games in 1992.
